description: The profit or loss and the ROI percentage from an initial investment and a final value (ROI = (final - initial) / initial x 100). Negative results are valid. It is not annualized. Use for questions about the total percentage return on money put in, from two values. Do not use for a return per year (use the CAGR calculator at smartfin.fyi/cagr-calculator.html), for what a real stock returned (use smartfin_calculate_investment_return), or for fees and taxes: include them in the final value yourself.

final_value.description: Final value in dollars; it can be below the initial amount
